BiblicalUsage: Pathros is a part of Egypt, the land of Upper Egypt, the home of the Pathrusim. God promises in Isaiah 11:11 to recover the remnant of His people from Pathros, and in Jeremiah 44:1 the word comes to the Jews who dwell in Egypt, in Pathros. Ezekiel 29:14 says God will bring back the captivity of Egypt and cause them to return into the land of Pathros, the land of their habitation.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Pathros is the far edge of the exile, and God's promise reaches it: the remnant will be recovered from the very place they were scattered to.
RelatedTopics: Exile; Return from exile; God's promises
